name: Cam-unfolding link: a cam-slaved knee K = c(q2) in link 2 (pin-knee closure, sensor-free)
lens: overhead-first; round 6 lens 1 (sensor-free knuckle), arm-side variant
family: redundant 4R with a cam-slaved 4th joint (3 active)

mechanism.notes: the pin knee (rows/skin-normal-3r-pin-knee.json mechanism) + K: link 2 split into 2a / 2b by an O20 passive bearing-pair pin, NOT sensed (K = c(q2) is read from q2), slaved by a groove face cam on link 1 at J2 (O3 iglidur-sleeved follower pin on a lever of 2a = 1 sliding pair) through an O2 pushrod (2 pins) to a 4 mm crank on 2b: +2 bodies (2b, pushrod), +3 joints, 1 closed loop; complexity 33.75 (tools/simplicity.py; the pin knee 19.5)

verdict: Screened, not a contender (convergence gate pending on the S2 continuation): best 27.07 near-touch / 25.85 plain fast (score 90.2), reach 0.700, in-band 0.842, contact 0; the plain pin knee at the same seats (no K) scores 27.68 at in-band 0.92, so the cam-slaved arm-side knee earns ~0-2 points for +14.25 complexity.
limiter: hub K on link 2 sweeps a q1 x q2 patch of skin: an O20 GH-ray disc there is in band only within 22-40 deg of J2, toward J1 (clashes with hub 1 over the q2 window) or along link 2's line (K nearly straight: no leverage on a2); elsewhere its 5-95 % skin-height spread is 19-35 mm vs the 12 mm band (K-atlas). At the CMA best hub K is 0.42 in band, L2a 0.52; fold still costs 36 poses, overhead reach 0/12.
